title: Engraving
description: Parameters of an 'engrave' operation (cam.h Operation::paramsJson, task T-056): the tool centre follows picked edges and text of one or more lines on a plane, at a depth below it, plunging straight in (a centre-cutting engraving cutter, spot drill, pointed chamfer mill or ball end mill). The operation's geometry is any number of edges of the part, projected along the setup's Z onto the plane; the text is laid out in the RayCAD Single Line font. Its heights are absolute WCS Z: 'top' is the engraving plane, 'clearance', 'retract' and 'feedPlane' are the usual levels above it; 'bottom' is not used (the depth is a parameter). Feeds: the cutting feed along the strokes, the plunge feed into the material. Lengths are millimetres, angles degrees. Annotations for editors: 'x-unit' (length, angle, count, percent), 'x-multiline' (a text edited on several lines), 'x-enumTitles' (labels of an enum, in order), 'x-enumDescriptions' (a detail line for each enum value), 'x-relevantWhen' (the property matters only when every named property has one of the listed values), 'x-propertyOrder' (the order of the form), 'x-heightsUsed' (the members of the operation's heights this type reads, each with what it is measured from), 'x-cuttingUsed' (the members of its cutting data this type reads), 'x-geometry' (what the geometry picker selects: here edges) and 'x-toolTypes' (the tools the picker offers first); docs/operation_types.md defines each.

x-geometry.description: Click the edges to engrave (none for text alone).

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: How deep the tool tip goes below the engraving plane (the top height).

stepDown.title: Step down
stepDown.description: The most depth one pass takes; 0: the whole depth in one pass.

text.title: Text
text.description: The text to engrave, on one or more lines (a line break starts the next line; empty: edges only). Letters A to Z and a to z, digits, space and . , : ; - + = / # ( ) [ ] < > _ ! ? * ' " % and the degree and diameter signs.

font.title: Font
font.description: The single-line (stroke) font the text is drawn in.
x-enumDescriptions: Lines and arcs, capitals and digits 12 units high

textHeight.title: Text height
textHeight.description: The height of the capital letters and digits.

textSpacing.title: Extra spacing
textSpacing.description: Space added between two characters, beyond the font's own.

lineSpacing.title: Line spacing
lineSpacing.description: From one line's baseline to the next, in percent of the text height (text of more than one line).

textAlign.title: Alignment
textAlign.description: Where the text's position is: at the left end, the middle or the right end of the baseline, each line aligned on its own; the position is on the first line's baseline.

textX.title: Text X
textX.description: X of the text's position on the plane (WCS).

textY.title: Text Y
textY.description: Y of the text's position on the plane (WCS).

textAngle.title: Text angle
textAngle.description: The direction of the baseline, counter-clockwise from +X.

fitArcs.title: Fit arcs to sampled curves
fitArcs.description: Edges that are not lines or circles (splines, ellipses) reach the operation as many short lines; on: runs of three or more of them are replaced by arcs within 0.001 mm.
